entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Lima, founded by Pizarro in 1535 as 'La Ciudad de los Reyes,' became the wealthiest and most important city in Spanish South America — seat of the viceroy, the Inquisition, and the oldest university in the Americas (San Marcos, 1551). Colonial society was rigidly stratified by the sistema de castas
